speaker: Doctor
text: Given your history of tics and current use of haloperidol, have you experienced any muscle stiffness, rigidity, or excessive sweating recently? I need to rule out neuroleptic malignant syndrome, so please describe any changes in your muscle tone or temperature regulation.
